plugins.name: Failovarr
plugins.description: Consolidate N IPTV providers into unified channels with cross-provider failover, by deterministic normalized-name matching (no fuzzy). One channel per normalized name, both providers' streams stacked as failover, so a channel enabled on either provider is never lost. Locals key on callsign; PPV/event groups skipped; adult split; deterministic EPG match with free logos. In-place reconcile, safe to run daily.
plugins.author: Roy Dufek
